positions.question: Do you support expanding federal funding to support social safety net programs such as Social Security and Medicare?

evidence.text: "Door knocking in Caldwell today I heard from so many voters that felt the same way. Protect & expand Social Security & Medicare. Protect women's autonomy & choice. Hold elected officials accountable. Get registered. VOTE!"
"Idahoans deserve the Social Security they have paid into with a lifetime of hard work, they deserve someone who votes for them... #idpol #idleg #SocialSecurity #retirement"

"Let us recognize the truth behind Social Security and Medicare: they are not entitlements but earned benefits through decades of hard work and contributions to society.
